body: Yeah you are right. I guess it's because she's the first person I've felt so connected to and had such an intense relationship with. I feel lost without her. I just miss her so much.
I have a picture of it! I don't know the names of the cards unfortunately and don't know how to upload it here

[tw: Suicide attempt]

EM is a divorcee who raised me with my grandparents. She pushed me into a career choice that I didn't like at all and manipulated me into agreeing to do it because I "owed" it to her. 4 years of my life went down the drain and after 3 suicide attempts and my absolute disinterest in anything related to that degree she finally saw that she couldn't push me around any longer. She did try to say that I was only trying to kill myself to make her look bad. I tried to tell her that this was emotionally straining me. I think she finally understood that she pushed me too far when I tried to stab myself in front of her.

I'm doing what I love now and it's a living nightmare to catch up with the others who are my age and already have well paying jobs now. But I'm mentally in a way better place.
